name: io.github.j4flmao/slim-sheet
title: slim-sheet
description: Spreadsheet MCP for any agent: reads xlsx/xls/ods/csv, SQL, cleaning, formulas, safe edits

environmentVariables.name: SLIM_SHEET_TIER
